resources.string: Enter a valid session API key.
Microphone access is required. Tap Record to ask again, or open app settings.
Could not record audio. Check microphone access and record again for at least a second.
Connection failed or timed out. Retry or delete this recording.
API key rejected. Check the key and project access, then retry.
API limit or balance reached. Check your API account before retrying.
API request failed. Check model availability or retry later.
No usable text returned. Retry or record again.
Uses gpt-transcribe. Stop uploads audio to OpenAI using your key and may incur API charges. Check current pricing and your billing settings before recording. No automatic retries.

Key and draft stay in memory only. Audio is kept privately for retry until you cancel, leave the app or succeed. Recording stops after 2 minutes. Leaving or rotating cancels recording/upload. Copy shares text with the system clipboard.
